name: 2D Histogram Visualization
aliases: Scatterplot of Gradient Magnitude and Intensity
definition: A precomputed 2D histogram used as a visual aid to convey sparse regions of the range space, colored by the number of voxels in each bin.
summary: 2D Histogram Visualization maps voxel counts to color in a discrete bin grid, replacing continuous scatterplots to simplify transfer function design and highlight sparse regions.
